text:
Nina: Async CS standup — Northbridge renewal flagged. What I did: ran rollout in staging, webhook retries keep failing for POST /events (500). Attached sample log + trace id. Blocker: need eng to prevent duplicate processing and change retry-backoff; CS can't move rollout without fix. Today: need eng triage and ETA.

Mike: +1. Steps to reproduce: curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/nb/events -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"id":"abc123","payload":"..."}' — logs show 500 then immediate retry. Sample log: ```2026-03-16T09:12:03Z ERROR webhook failed id=abc123 status=500 trace=nb-77f5```

Jordan: I'll pick this up. Can you drop the trace id and customer org id? Also, do we have the request body (weird content-length?)

Nina: trace=nb-77f5, org=northbridge-prod-3. I attached the request payload to the ticket. It's standard, no large attachments. CS can grant eng temporary access to their logs/tenant.

Jordan: thanks. I'll start a quick repro against staging and look at the webhook handler. Initial guess: our idempotency key is missing for this path, so retries double-post. Will check KV cache TTL and retry policy. ETA end of day if no infra changes, earlier if quick fix.

Sara: FYI I saw increased 5xx patterns Monday night — I can roll a canary config to add a 2s jitter to retries if you want to reduce load while eng patches. :mechanical_arm:

Jordan: good call. Nina — are you ok with a temporary client-side backoff change? CS prefers server-side guard but will accept canary.

Nina: OK to ask customer to enable client backoff 2s jitter for rollout window. Also need communication template for renewals team — I'll draft.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline status: no infra deploys pending. If Jordan opens PR with feature flag 'webhook-idempotency-nb', canary roll approved.

Jordan: opening PR now, will ping when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/pull/4821 :thumbsup:

Mike: thanks all — assigning follow-ups: Jordan (triage & PR), Sara (canary backoff), Nina (customer comms).
